limitations: Not full Tom engine calibration: the journal constrains observed accounting, not Tom's native operation-5 placement or complete simulator behavior.
Automatic stream decoded using retained build-272 parser grammar on observed build 273; full parser drift has not been independently ruled out.
Reconstructed raw damage uses separately rounded components and an explicit diagnostic ±2.01 allowance. Its nearest integer is not a reported server raw value.

Across 82 clean hits the ratio to nearest reconstructed integer is approximately 0.711999998818803, but exact coefficient 0.712 with slightly fractional raw damage also fits. The tiny tail cannot select a server precision variant.
Critical hits, shield-depleted hits, and the terminal lethal hit remain in the fixture but are excluded from the clean mitigation and shield-share tests.
Charge markers are separate short events without damage fields.
